name: Custom terms stated by the provider
notes: Requires `license_url` pointing at the provider's own terms — an EDI intellectualRights page, a portal's Data Use Policy, an ERDDAP .das `license` global, a data-sharing agreement. The index and the release fail without the URL. Declared by phyllosoma, euphausiids, zoodb, zooscan, farallon, cufes.

name: Not yet established
notes: Fails the index and the release unless an open/proposed questions.csv row with related_table = dataset covers `license`. An empty license is treated the same way; prefer leaving the field empty with the question filed.
